pages.content: Title page and introduction. States export format is C-CDA or CSV. Navigation path: Administration >> Practice Setup >> Data Export.
pages.key_quote: The documentation for the export format consists of information on the structure and syntax for how the EHI will be exported by the product such as, for example, Consolidated-Clinical Document Architecture (C-CDA) document(s) or data dictionary for comma separated values (csv) file(s).

pages.content: Patient selection UI. Shows search by Name or Account Number. Single or multiple patient selection.
Multiple patient selection screen. 'Select All Patients' checkbox for bulk export.
Export form fields: Archive Name, File Type (dropdown - value not shown), Encryption Key, Comments, Submit button. Backend program scheduled daily to process exports.
pages.notable: File Type dropdown is visible but empty/value not documented. No indication of what file type options exist.

pages.content: Step 1: Request submitted, status 'New' on Data Export Screen. Table columns: Archive Name, Date Generated, Created By, Status, Expiry Date.
Steps 2-3: Status progression from 'InProgress' to 'Completed'. Download option visible only to requestor. Expiry dates shown.
pages.notable: Practice Setup tabs visible: General, Billing, Schedule, EMR, Allergy, Meaningful Use, Menu Privileges, Data Export

pages.content: Download section. Shows ZIP files (QAT_1.zip, QAT_2.zip, QAT_3.zip). Patient folder structure. Text: 'Download the Folder and Select the Patient folder to view C-CDA in XML files'.
pages.notable: Export output confirmed as C-CDA XML files organized in per-patient folders within ZIP archives.

pages.content: Shows ClinicalSummary XML file in patient folder. Patient Portal document download option.
pages.notable: File named 'QAT-1-11142023_ClinicalSummary' (XML Document). Patient Portal also provides C-CDA download under Documents.
